kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Classical Persian آزَاددَرَخْت (āzād-daraxt, literally “noble tree”), from آزَاد (āzād, “noble”) + دَرَخْت (daraxt, “tree”).
g: Azadirachta indica syn. Melia azedarach (called in English ambiguously chinaberry, white cedar, Persian lilac, and unambiguously syringa berry, bead tree and azedarach)
